top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 chain from proglucagon processing and human incretin physiology (Holst), through receptor biology (Drucker), to albumin-binding long-acting analogues (Knudsen) is mature and confirmed by independent outcome trials. A Physiology or Medicine prize that carries physiology into patients should credit each stage, and the Mojsov priority for GLP-1(7-36) is contested and cannot be verified from the supplied material, so I would not rest a seat on it. P001 is a scientifically sound alternative that weights discovery of the active form differently, and I rank it clearly above no award.
